summary: The barracks trains every Russian infantry unit and heals wounded foot soldiers for free. It also refills the Molniya crews that wait beside it. It has no weapon, draws power and needs a power plant before a dozer can raise it.

sections.title: Train infantry
sections.how: Select the barracks, open the Build tab and press Rifleman, RPG gunner or Molniya crew.
sections.body: The barracks trains all three Russian foot units. Press a tile to queue one, press + on its tile to queue another and − to cancel the last one. The head item shows a clock wipe while it is being trained. New soldiers leave by the building exit; set a rally point so they walk where they are needed.

sections.title: Rally point
sections.how: Select the barracks, press Rally point and left-click the ground.
sections.body: Infantry trained afterwards leaves the barracks and walks to the rally point. Changing the point only affects units produced later. The marker shows while the barracks is selected.

sections.title: Heal infantry
sections.how: Select damaged riflemen, RPG gunners or Molniya crews and left-click the barracks.
sections.body: The patients walk in and heal free of charge while the barracks keeps training. They are hidden and safe inside, and leave on their own once whole. Up to ten fit at once; full-health infantry stay outside. If the barracks is destroyed or sold, its patients are thrown out, and one with nowhere to stand can die in the collapse.

sections.title: Resupply Molniya crews
sections.how: Park a Molniya crew beside the barracks; no order is needed.
sections.body: A Molniya crew carries three fibre-guided drones, shown as pips over the selected crew. With empty pips it cannot launch. While a short crew waits beside the barracks, one charge comes back after a wait; leaving the area resets the clock. A supply truck does the same job in the field, and a supply center at home.

sections.title: Repair with a dozer
sections.how: Select a dozer and left-click the damaged barracks.
sections.body: The dozer drives to the building and restores it until it is whole. The work costs half the build price as the health comes back, and only one dozer works on it at a time. If the credits run out, the repair stops and the dozer goes idle.

sections.title: Sell
sections.how: Select the barracks and press Sell twice.
sections.body: It sells for half its price and disappears at once. Any infantry still in its queue is cancelled and refunded in full, and its patients are thrown out. Selling your last building loses the match.

strong: A base close to the front line
tips: Build a power plant first: the barracks needs one and draws power from it.
Place it behind the line but within walking distance of the front, so wounded infantry can reach it.
Set a rally point toward the front so new infantry do not crowd the exit.
Park Molniya crews beside it between sorties; their drone pips refill only while they stay close.
Molniya drones fly on a fibre link, so jammers cannot cut them; bring the crew back to the barracks for fresh charges.
Keep a dozer nearby: the barracks cannot repair itself.
Queue infantry before a fight; training continues while the barracks heals its patients.
